mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, table_no, total_amount, item_count, remark, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{tableNo}, #{totalAmount}, #{itemCount}, #{remark}, #{status})
INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, dish_id, dish_name, emoji, price, `count`, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{dishId}, #{name}, #{emoji}, #{price}, #{count}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, dish_id, dish_name AS name, emoji, price, `count`, subtotal FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
